remarks: Charming and bright one level remodeled 1 bedroom apartment. Fully equipped kitchen with maple cabinets plus washer and dryer. Open floor plan with lots of light. Half wall separates bedroom space. All utilities (heat, water, A/C and WiFi) included in the rent. Small private patio outside the sliding glass door. Parking for one car only. Tenant is responsibile for liability insurance, credit check & references a must! Owner reserves the right to interview and meet potential tenant. Pets on case by case basis.
